title: Official Netflix KPop Demon Hunters live world tour coming to Manchester AO Arena - Yahoo News UK
text:

 News Finance More Mail Search the web Advertisement Advertisement Return to homepage Official Netflix KPop Demon Hunters live world tour coming to Manchester AO Arena
 James McNeill Sat, 14 November 2026 at 5:00 am UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. The Kpop Demon Hunters Golden World Tour is coming to Manchester (Image: Supplied) A global K-pop concert experience is heading to the AO Arena as part of a major international tour.
 The KPop Demon Hunters Golden World Tour will arrive in Manchester on Tuesday, October 19, 2027, as one of five UK dates.
 Inspired by Netflix's most popular film of all time, the live experience will bring the animated HUNTR/X universe and its characters to the stage through cutting-edge technology and performance.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Marian Lee, Netflix's chief marketing officer, said: "KPop Demon Hunters has transformed from a breakout hit into a generational phenomenon, sustaining 63 consecutive weeks in Netflix's Global Top 10, eclipsing 2 billion Spotify streams for 'Golden,' and breaking the all-time record for the longest running soundtrack at No. 1 on Billboard's Top Soundtracks chart.
 "This fandom was never about a single moment, and the Golden World Tour is how we keep it going, bringing that 'Takedown' energy to arenas around the world, where fans can sing, dance and help HUNTR/X seal the Honmoon."
 The tour will span nearly 50 cities across 2027 and 2028, with more than 150 performances planned worldwide.
 Other dates in the UK include Utilita Arena Birmingham on Saturday, October 16 and London at the O2 from October 22 to 23.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Additional dates in the Asia-Pacific and Latin America regions are expected to be announced soon.
 The show will feature live-action stunts, interactive storytelling, choreography, and appearances by both live performers and animated characters, including the Saja Boys and Derpy Tiger.
 Creative direction is led by Amy Tinkham, known for her work on major live productions such as Disney's Descendants/Zombies: Worlds Collide Tour and Cirque du Soleil's Songblazers.
 Tickets go on general sale at 10am on Friday, November 20, with presales beginning earlier in the week.
 The Mastercard presale opens at 10am on Wednesday, November 18, followed by the FOR THE FANS presale at 10am on Thursday, November 19.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement A limited number of VIP packages will also be available, offering exclusive merchandise, on-stage photo opportunities, and preshow parties.
 Rich Schaefer, president of global touring at AEG Presents, said: "KPop Demon Hunters has become a global phenomenon, with characters and music that already mean so much to fans around the world.
 "We're excited to work with Netflix to bring that world to life on tour, with the music at the heart of a show that makes fans part of the adventure.

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "The Golden World Tour gives us the chance to create something special for this incredible audience and bring fans of every generation together to experience it."
 The KPOP DEMON HUNTERS film, released on June 20, 2025, has surpassed 670 million views and earned multiple major awards, including an Academy Award for Best Animated Feature.
 More information can be found here: www.kpopdemonhunterstour.com
